source: SQL-first acceptance on the strict typed variable graph (ADR-025)

criteria.requirement: Composition schema: entry_query, tags, and every label field make YAML invalid; there is no compatibility parser.
Form to SQL: selecting Form G generates SELECT * FROM "G"; SQL query limit=50 is separate from SQL text LIMIT.

selectors.name: Form bindings create variable-backed displays with explicit aggregation
Composition Studio adds a no-entry Form table beside an existing query and reopens it

criteria.requirement: Source binding: Form rename follows immutable identity; same-name Form replacement fails; ACL revocation or a missing Form stops with source_unavailable.

selectors.name: evaluate rechecks Form and exact Saved SQL access after revocation

criteria.requirement: Saved SQL: pin an exact revision with no latest fallback, silent rebind, or mutation; duplication creates inline SQL.

selectors.name: Pinned Saved SQL source supports an explicit inline copy and explicit counts

criteria.requirement: Variables: Composition defaults match their type; required, unset, and invalid values remain distinct; SQL is never interpolated. Saved SQL defaults are typed in standalone preview.
manual_evidence_gaps: Standalone-preview handling of Saved SQL defaults is not verified by the vNext tests selected here.

criteria.requirement: SQL functions: read-only SQL supports COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX and existing join/group/distinct parsing; the UI does not unconditionally generate disallowed scalar or window functions.
SQL editing: GUI actions never overwrite hand-edited SQL without consent; unsupported complex SQL remains editable, saveable, and validatable in the code editor.
Query paging: only explicit sql.query.count counts; continuations recheck authorization; stale query/result is suppressed; the client does not aggregate all pages.

selectors.name: Table pagination leaves the SQL Metric and typed Input unchanged
Pinned Saved SQL source supports an explicit inline copy and explicit counts

criteria.requirement: Metric: distinguish zero rows, one NULL row, zero, multiple rows, and type mismatch; derive headings from SQL result aliases; persist no label.

selectors.name: API evaluates an exact Saved SQL revision and reports scalar cardinality failures

criteria.requirement: Composition Studio: test 320, 375, 390, 760, and 1280px across available modes; no page horizontal overflow; mode targets are at least 44px; keyboard focus remains visible at every tested width; touch selection, light/dark mode, and 16px input text work. Verify actual 200% browser zoom and iPhone Safari separately.

selectors.name: Composition Studio responsive modes fit target viewports and support keyboard and touch

manual_evidence_gaps: Actual browser 200% zoom and iPhone Safari device verification

criteria.requirement: UI: no persistent explanatory paragraphs, decorative cards, or tag/label editors; exactly one Back and one Save action; selecting a row selects the whole row.

selectors.name: Composition Studio responsive modes fit target viewports and support keyboard and touch

criteria.requirement: Accessibility: every icon-only control has aria-label/title and visible focus, targets are at least 44px, drawers trap and restore focus, and dialogs support keyboard and Escape. Verify VoiceOver/NVDA separately.

selectors.name: Composition Studio responsive modes fit target viewports and support keyboard and touch

criteria.requirement: Recovery: one Composition Entry revision per save; return receipts; stale base revisions conflict; distinguish unknown outcomes. Undo appends a publication and never rewinds the head destructively.

selectors.name: Composition save reconciles a lost response without duplicate publication
Composition raw recovery preserves caller-visible contracts
Browser saves a tool once, reopens its exact revision from Home, and pages parameterized results with model connection disabled
Composition Studio builds a reusable tool from existing knowledge

criteria.requirement: CLI and WASM: share the Composition schema, resolution, diagnostics, and SQL preview semantics; raw export/history remain usable with no legacy executable decoder.
